title: Exclusion of Privileged Persons from General Baggage Rules
summary: The concept evolves from a standard exclusion clause in baggage rules to a more explicit and nuanced definition of non-applicability. Over time, the language shifts from referencing the 2003 Rules as a blanket exclusion to explicitly naming 'Privileged Persons' as a distinct category excluded from the scope of baggage regulations.

evolution.scope: From referencing the 2003 Rules as a legal instrument to identifying the status of 'Privileged Person' as the basis for exclusion.

timeline.change: Initial establishment of exclusion for Privileged Persons (Customs Procedures) Rules 2003.
Shift from referencing the 2003 Rules to explicitly naming 'Privileged Person' as a category excluded from the scope.
